title: News Words: Rustic
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7997121.html

sentences.text: Welcome to the Voice of America's Newswords.
A tiny island of Singapore sits just 17 kilometers away from the highly developed city -state.
The island of Pulau Ubin has a small population.
Chuyokchun is one of 30 people living there, down from almost 4 ,060 years ago.
Chuy said he enjoys life on the Rustic Island, but does not see much of a future for its community.
Rustic describes things that are simple and usually have a rough, wood -like appearance.
Rustic designs are often found in rural environments.
